evals.name: single-skill-gate-after-edit
evals.prompt: I just edited the foo-bar skill. Run the hygiene gate on it.
evals.expected_output: Loads the conventions skill (or states the fallback), reviews foo-bar against the checklist quoting offending lines, greps for cross-skill references, runs the lint runner with .agents as the argument, proposes fixes via AskUserQuestion, applies approved ones, and reports before/after scores.
assertions: Lint runner invoked with the parent of skills/, not .agents/skills
Run validity checked: the skills-checked count equals the target count, with per-skill symlink re-runs on a shortfall
Report shows before and after scores

evals.name: cross-reference-classification
evals.prompt: Audit all my skills. One of them names another skill in its body.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the hit: a finding unless the user explicitly granted that dependency and the text states a fallback; runtime naming in questions/reports is not a finding. Published-channel skills get the absolute rule.
assertions: Distinguishes authored-text references from runtime naming
Granted dependency requires both an explicit user grant and a stated fallback
Published skills held to the absolute no-reference rule

evals.name: degrades-without-the-runner
evals.prompt: Review the foo skill on a machine without the internal-skills repo.
evals.expected_output: Falls back to the inline checklist as the gate, says so plainly in the report, and does not fabricate a lint score.
assertions: Checklist review still performed in full

evals.name: gather-stops-after-scoring
evals.prompt: Run skill-review over every installed skill with the argument gather.
evals.expected_output: Runs steps 1 to 4, returns per skill the findings list and the lint score, and makes no AskUserQuestion call and no file change.
assertions: Every target skill has a findings list and a score from a valid run
